messages:
deploy-bot: Starting fanout deploy to `staging` for services: runtime, api, console. tag=v1.14.0-rc3 commit=a3f5c1d change-window=02:00-04:00UTC parallelism=3. will post per-service status updates.
alex: ack — watching logs and tracing. will grab runtime traces if latency spikes. :eyes:
jess: pinned runtime config to v1.14.0-rc3 (perftune=trace-enabled=false) to avoid noise during smoke tests. api pinned? nate, you handling api healthchecks?
nate: on it. kicking off `kubectl rollout status` on api canary now. smoke tests queued.
deploy-bot: runtime: STARTED on gpu-stg-04 (node=gpu-stg-04) — warming KV cache.
deploy-bot: console: STARTED on web-stg-02 (node=web-stg-02) — asset build in progress.
deploy-bot: api: STARTED on svc-stg-01 (node=svc-stg-01) — readiness probes enabled.
alex: runtime logs show 2x tokenization spikes during first 30s, but p50 latency ok. continuing monitor.
nate: api smoke failed: 503 from /healthcheck in 3/5 attempts. logs show DB migration lock timeout `ERROR: could not obtain lock`.
jess: rollback policy: if api smoke >20% fail OR any 5xx during canary, rollback api and notify infra. agree to rollback now?
sam: +1 — do rollback for api, keep runtime & console rolling, we don't want user-visible errors.
deploy-bot: API HEALTHCHECK: FAILED — initiating rollback for api to tag=v1.13.9 commit=b7d2e9a. running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=previous`.
oncall-bot: paging @oncall if rollback doesn't finish in 10m.
morgan: FYI for release notes: drop note about migration change under api section and mention mitigation steps. I'll update the draft.
jess: make sure we capture which customer-facing feature was gated by the migration so PM can decide docs/comms.
deploy-bot: api ROLLBACK: SUCCESS — api reverted to v1.13.9, healthchecks passing. runtime: FINISHED (ok). console: FINISHED (ok). summary: runtime=ok, console=ok, api=rolled-back -> stable. duration=2m45s.
alex: thanks y'all. will keep an eye on telemetry for the next 30m. :thumbsup:
nate: will add the migration lock troubleshooting notes to the incident doc and link commit hashes.
sam: flagged for follow-up with infra about migration locking under staging-only config.
morgan: updated release notes with a short paragraph and the rollback entry, pushed to `release-notes/staging/v1.14.0-rc3.md`.
oncall-bot: monitoring: created alert channel #alerts-api for any 5xx spikes, threshold=5/min.
jess: retro note — consider making api deploy wait for migration lock to clear or run migrations as a separate pre-deploy job. filing a follow-up ticket. :memo:
deploy-bot: Deploy fanout complete for thread 1865432100 — final state: runtime=deployed(tag=v1.14.0-rc3), console=deployed(tag=v1.14.0-rc3), api=rolled-back(to=v1.13.9). If you need a manual rollback for runtime/console, call `deploy rollback --service <name> --to-tag <tag>`.
alex: closing watch. thanks everyone.
